title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Upload PDF files to a conversation (Beta)**: You can now upload PDF files to a Genie One conversation alongside CSV and Excel files. Genie One parses PDFs asynchronously. See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file).
* **Mention workspace users in document comments**: In a document, you can now mention workspace users in a comment.
* **Genie Ontology enabled by default (Public Preview)**: The ontology is a unified context layer that gives Genie a business-aware map of your organization. It is now enabled by default. See [Genie Ontology](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#ontology).
